{{Quote|Why should I try on a ''blast synchronizer''?|C-3PO|<ref name="GW" />}}
A '''blast synchronizer''' was a weapon for sale at [[Kitak Hu]]'s weapons shop on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]]. It fit over the faceplate of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] once suggested [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] wear one to become a weapon droid.
